title_en: Character Riddles (20/20): The Sun Just Above Ten
note_en: 越……越…… means "the more… the more…": 太阳越升越高，祖孙俩的影子也越来越短 "the higher the sun rose, the shorter their shadows grew." With a single verb, 越来越 means "more and more," as in 越来越短 "shorter and shorter"; unlike English, no "the" or comparative ending is needed, since 越 does all the work.
